The '''High Priest House''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. The building was connected to the [[Priest House]], the [[House of War]], and the [[Audience Hall]]. The High Priest House was an ornate dwelling with large chambers and airy lofts. [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]] lived in the structure, alongside a number of lesser [[Priest/Legends|priests]] who served him.<ref name="BGS" />
